description: Legislative sessions (GET /v1/sessions): regular and special sessions with their years, start/sine-die dates and a session_id. Use this to resolve which session a bill belongs to, to find the current session for a state, or to pass session_id as a filter to search_bills. Omit `state` to list every jurisdiction's sessions. Corpus is 2026-forward only.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. FL), DC, or US for Congress.

name: list_sessions
title: List legislative sessions
